description: Get the learner-time RUN manifest for the current scene — the provisioning/run instructions {capsule_ref, cmd, working_dir?, timeout_s?, requirements?, expected_outputs[], verify_checks[], research_question?} — when the current scene is a reproduction the LEARNER must run, else null. NON-answer-bearing (no expected values, no author landmark): the operator provisions the env, installs the deps, runs `cmd` IN THE WORKSPACE, then calls submit_run_result. `learner_run_recorded: true` means this session already holds the learner's attested run for this scene (a revisit after a detour): re-run if you want a fresh result, or submit_response {kind:"ack"} to continue.
name: get_run_manifest
